eyebrow: Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR & KQL · Chapter 2
subtitle: Lesson 7 · KQL Fundamentals

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize FailedSignIns = count() by UserPrincipalName
| sort by FailedSignIns desc
caption: summarize collapses every row into one row per distinct UserPrincipalName, counting failed sign-ins per user.

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize DistinctIPs = dcount(IPAddress) by UserPrincipalName
caption: dcount() counts distinct IP addresses per user — a sudden jump often signals a compromised account.

code:
Perf
| where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time"
| summarize AvgCPU = avg(CounterValue) by Computer
caption: avg() works the same way — one average per Computer group, from the Perf table any connected machine reports to.
